page.content:
LEGOLAND Fire was a subtheme of LEGOLAND from 1970 to 1976, there were 12 sets released during this time. Many of the sets from this theme were either fire engine trucks or fire stations.

page.overview:
What is LEGOLAND Fire?

LEGOLAND Fire was a subtheme of LEGOLAND from 1970 to 1976, there were 12 sets released during this time. Many of the sets from this theme were either fire engine trucks or fire stations.
